_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround i runga i tetahi {width}x{height} grid.
Ko koe te kaiwhaiwhakaaro {player_id}. Neke whai mana: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' ki te 'w/s/a/d'.
Whainga: kia ora ake koe i etahi atu katoa. Ko nga ara e whakamate ana; ko nga pakarutanga ki te taha e whakamate; ko nga taru i runga i a koe e whakamate ana tahi.

game_action.invalid_death: Ka mate te kaitākaro {player_id} nā tētahi nekehanga kāore i tika.

outcome.survived_win: I ora te kaitākaro {player_id}; i hinga katoa nga tangata.
outcome.all_crashed: I hinga katoa ngā kaitākaro i te wā kotahi.
outcome.outlived: I ora ake te kaitākaro i ētahi atu katoa.
outcome.turn_limit: Ka tae te rohe huri - ka wikitoria te tangata e roa rawa ana.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Urutapanga whakamutunga o ngā rōpū (nga pai rawa → nga kino rawa): {groups}
